গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকার
অর্থ মন্ত্রণালয়
অভ্যন্তরীণ সম্পদ বিভাগ
(কাস্টমস)
প্রজ্ঞাপন
তারিখ: ১৫ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪৩১ বঙ্গাব্দ/ ২৯ মে, ২০২৪ খ্রিস্টাব্দ

Government of Bangladesh: This legal instrument is issued under the authority of the Government of Bangladesh.
Ministry of Finance: This instrument is promulgated by the Ministry of Finance.
Internal Resources Division: The Internal Resources Division is the specific administrative body responsible for issuing this notification under the Ministry of Finance.

Customs Act 2023: The Government is empowered under sub-section (1) of section 25 of this Act to grant customs duty exemptions on imports for industrial units within economic zones.
Bangladesh Economic Zones Act 2010: This Act provides the legal framework for the establishment and declaration of economic zones where the specific industrial duty exemptions are applicable.
Customs Duty: Full exemption from customs duty is granted for vehicles imported by industrial units located in economic zones, subject to specific investment, employment, and procedural conditions.
Standing Order No. 100/2000/Shulka: This standing order governs the terms for the transfer or sale of imported vehicles within a specified period of five years from the date of importation.
National Board of Revenue: The Board is consulted in the exercise of powers to grant customs duty exemptions and maintains regulatory oversight over the conditions of vehicle disposal.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: ২। ১ জুলাই, ২০১৫ খ্রিস্টাব্দ তারিখে জারীকৃত প্রজ্ঞাপন এস.আর.ও. নং ২১০-আইন/২০১৫/৪৭/কাস্টমস এতদ্দ্বারা রহিত করা হইল।

S.R.O. 210-AIN/2015: This customs notification, which was originally issued on a specific date in July 2015, is hereby repealed.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: ৩। এই প্রজ্ঞাপন ৬ জুন, ২০২৪ খ্রিস্টাব্দ তারিখে কার্যকর হইবে।

Statutory Regulatory Order: This notification specifies the date on which the legal instrument becomes effective and enforceable.
